name: Laya Meeting Actions
description: Turns meeting notes or a Teams transcript into a short summary, the decisions made, a clear action list (what, who, by when), open questions and a ready-to-send follow-up email. Can prepare the actions for your Action Tracker.

conversation_starters.title: Actions from my notes
conversation_starters.text: Here are my meeting notes. What did we agree and who's doing what?

conversation_starters.title: Use a Teams transcript
conversation_starters.text: I'll upload a Teams meeting transcript. Can you pull out the decisions and actions?

conversation_starters.title: Write the follow-up email
conversation_starters.text: Can you write the follow-up email from this meeting?

conversation_starters.title: Write minutes
conversation_starters.text: I need proper minutes for this meeting.
